Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Grafton
Subsurface scientific mooring temporarily established 5 metres above the lakebed at:
43 57.196N 078 00.828W
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed.
